title: Prescribing coefficients of invariant irreducible polynomials over finite fields: counterexamples, corrected formulas, and complete restoration
description:
Audit of G. Kapetanakis, Prescribing coefficients of invariant irreducible polynomials, J. Number Theory 180 (2017), 615-628. Several statements of that paper are shown to be false or unproved: the coefficient formula of Theorem 2.8, inequality (5) and Table 2, Theorem 3.4(2), the diagonal case of Theorem 3.4, and the proof of Theorem 3.4(3). Complete statements and proofs are given; both existence statements hold with no exceptional pairs, the finitely many cases not reached by the bounds being settled by explicit polynomials.

The record contains the note (LaTeX and PDF), the verification program, its log and data, and the figures.
